title: Token provenance and microtype scale for dense analytics widgets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Our analytics surfaces and compact tables have drifted visually because teams have been consuming ad-hoc token overrides. This ticket establishes a provable token provenance map and introduces a microtype scale tuned for dense, high-information widgets (sparklines, compact tables, small charts). Goals: 1) Centralize origin metadata for color/spacing/typography tokens so we can trace where overrides come from; 2) Introduce a constrained microtype scale (3-4 micro steps) for 10–12px UI text used inside dense components; 3) Adjust radius and shadow intervals to read crisply at small sizes; 4) Provide migration guidance and a lightweight audit tooling checklist for component owners.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Token metadata where used shows 'source' and 'introduced_by' fields in the token registry UI for all palette, type, spacing, and elevation tokens used by analytics components.
2) New microtype scale (micro-xxs, micro-xs, micro-sm) defined in token spec, with CSS variables and Figma styles published.
3) Visual regression tests updated for 12 canonical compact components and baseline screenshots approved by design and QA.
4) Migration guide with prioritized list of components and a 'safe migration' checklist merged into the design-docs Confluence page.
5) Two developer-facing examples (a compact table and a sparkline card) updated to the new tokens and merged in the component repo.
design_notes:
- Rationale: small text and tight radii show aliasing and inconsistent depth when tokens were interpolated from base scales. Creating a micro-scale avoids fractional px and keeps shadows within device pixel constraints.
- Color provenance: we will add an immutable provenance tag (e.g., "origin: palette-v5; introduced_by: DES-31207") exposed in the token registry export. This is audit-only; tokens won't change behavior at runtime.
- Microtype: prefer integer pixel sizes and whole-line-height steps to avoid subpixel line-height differences across browsers. Suggested micro sizes: 10px/12px/14px with 16/18/20 base scale preserved.
- Radius/elevation: define 2 micro radii (2px, 4px) and 3 micro elevation presets with reduced blur and Y-offset (e.g., 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)).
- Accessibility: ensure contrast tests run on micro-scale text; lower sizes must meet AA for body-sized text when used in critical labels.
implementation_steps:
1) Update token registry schema to include provenance fields and publish a new registry export.
2) Add microtype variables to the token set and push to Figma styles with a short rationale.
3) Create CSS variable wrappers in the design tokens package and add unit tests for exported values.
4) Tweak shadow/elevation presets in the design token file and update the tokens-to-css build.
5) Update 12 canonical components (compact table, sparkline card, metric tile, inline badges) with example PRs.
6) Run visual diff job on the components repo, review failures, and iterate.
7) Publish migration guide and schedule brown-bag session for component owners.
